errors.text: The proposed Cr-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at approximately 1000 °C.
None of the cited studies concerns a previously reported Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy alloy; several concern refractory alloys with densities far above 6 g/cm3.
The hypothesis proposes promoting Laves intermetallic precipitation even though the stated problem is to overcome limitations associated with stable intermetallic formation.
No specific Cr concentration, alloy composition, oxidation temperature and duration, corrosion electrolyte, or processing-temperature boundary is defined.
The evidence is transferred from chemically and physically dissimilar coatings, refractory alloys, and composites without justification that the mechanisms apply to Mg-containing lightweight alloys.
The experiment lacks an SPS-temperature control series and does not specify quantitative falsification thresholds or electrochemical and oxidation-kinetics measurements.
